votes.motion: Continuation of the 63 Peninsula Drive Request for Determination of Applicability hearing; minutes record the vote as 'Negative 3 Unanimous' with no outcome stated.
votes.quote: mark would like to modify the plan to rebuild just the patio; the size would be 14' x 28' instead of 14' x 32.5'. negative 3 unanimous

votes.motion: Approve the 43 Hemlock Terrace Notice of Intent for an addition of a 3-season, unheated room, after the room was moved back.
votes.quote: moved room back a few feet to move of the the 50' no-build zone. approved unanimous

votes.motion: Approve the 33 Birch Island Way Notice of Intent for removal and replacement of enclosed porch and repair of patio.
votes.quote: remove and repair patio where it is sinking. approved unanimous

votes.motion: Approve the 240-248 Townsend Harbor Road/1625 Massachusetts Avenue Notice of Intent filed by Conservation Commission for rehabilitation of the cart/walking path.
votes.quote: not within the wetland re source area. approved unanim ous

votes.motion: Discontinue the Associate Member position, suggesting it will not be filled at this time.
votes.quote: discontinuation of associate member ~ suggested that we will not fill the position at this time ~ approved unanimous

votes.motion: Rescind the non-compliance at 803 Leominster Road, given the remedial work timeline received from Tim Hillman.
votes.quote: rescind non-compliance; have recieved time line for remedial work from tim hillman. approved

votes.motion: Decline the Right of First Refusal on 145 Page Street (12.66 acres) at the $89,000 price.
votes.quote: the price of $89,000 is way above the price we paid per acre for the lane property. not interested unanimous
